objective: Prevent individually acceptable shots from being assembled into a visibly discontinuous video by requiring evidence at every adjacent shot boundary.
criticalDefects: principal identity changes across an adjacent-shot boundary
locked wardrobe changes without storyboard authorization
environment or lighting state jumps without storyboard authorization
persistent object disappearance or duplication across the boundary
audio discontinuity that materially interrupts required speech or music
boundary contains black, frozen, duplicated or missing frames
reviewProtocol: Review every adjacent shot boundary; for N shots require exactly N-1 seam reviews.
Inspect the end of the outgoing shot and beginning of the incoming shot at normal speed and frame-by-frame when a discontinuity is suspected.
Score continuity independently from within-shot quality; a strong shot cannot hide a poor boundary.
Fail the assembled candidate when any seam has a critical defect or misses the required score.
Do not invent transitions: CUT_ONLY assemblies remain cuts unless a separately governed transition contract authorizes another transition.
